cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable=true and data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event that correctly captures the product's title (from data-testid='product-title-1') and price (from data-testid='product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and Drop Product Item into Drop Area
cases.description: Verify that users can drag and drop product items (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') to add them to the cart.

cases.title: Automatic Cart Display Update on Drop
cases.description: Verify that upon dropping a product item, the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price appears in .box3, and the quantity appears in .box1.

cases.title: Support for Adding Different and Repeated Products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the cart via drag and drop.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price in Cart
cases.description: Verify that the system sums the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displays it in the div with id='allMoney'.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have corresponding test cases covering their explicit scenarios without any blockers or redundant excesses.
All requirements have corresponding test cases that accurately reflect the expected behaviors without blockers or missing scenarios.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initiating a drag event on an li element with draggable=true, capturing the product title, and capturing the product price using specified data-testid attributes. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: allowing drag and drop of product items into the designated drop area (id=div1, data-testid=drop-area), automatically updating the cart display with the product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1, and supporting both different and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: summing the prices of all products in the cart, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displaying the total in the div id=allMoney element. No explicit mention of negative, boundary, or abnormal scenarios was given in the requirements text, so only normal test scenarios are warranted based strictly on the provided text.
